description: MODEL EARTH is a multidisciplinary team developing a holographic platform to support astronauts in space exploration. We integrate satellite data, Earth environmental parameters, solar activity, and Earth–Sun interactions through 3D visualization and AI. Our vision extends to deep-space and interstellar missions. We welcome talent in aerospace engineering, astronomy, remote sensing, SAR, AI, programming, and 3D design. Local Winner NASA Space Apps 2025!
